periods.description: A mysterious flute-based power that can summon, hatch, or direct Abyss, overriding their usual indiscriminate hostility.

details.effect: draws out Abyss and causes large Abyss body to produce Gargoyles

activation.condition: possession of the flute and playing its discordant tone

effects: hatches Gargoyles from the large Abyss body
keeps controlled Abyss from attacking the flute holder

power_level.initial: can bring a single surprise Abyss to the academy
power_level.peak: creates a thirty-Gargoyle battlefield threat plus remnant army coordination

known_feats: Fugil claims he used the flute during the coup
Belbet uses it to hatch Gargoyles from the slime-like Abyss
countered_by: destroying or disarming the flute holder
